entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Elena Werner

entries.dialogueText: "It would seem so."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It's no small favor we're asking...."
entries.dialogueText: "It's no small favor we're asking. Expanding Rizia's share of the MITZ at the expense of Lespia is a huge risk."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It's no small favor we're asking...."
entries.dialogueText: "It's no small favor we're asking. Cutting Lespia out of the MITZ is a huge risk."

entries.dialogueText: "From what I can tell, she is allowing her personal sentiments about Rizia to spill over into her business dealings with us."

entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Your determination is second to no..."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""However, that means Ms. Saltana wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, that means Ms. Saltana will most likely withdraw her approval for the new MITZ proposal. Which means a return to the drawing board."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A return to the drawing board it i..."
entries.dialogueText: "A return to the drawing board it is, then. I'd rather fight with Lespia to keep the status quo than make any more changes."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Never mind, then. We can make a co..."

entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I confess I'm not looking forward..."
entries.dialogueText: "I confess I'm not looking forward to Prime Minister Alvarez's reaction."

entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""If we can follow through on this,..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we can follow through on this, it'll be the greatest diplomatic coup since the MITZ was originally founded."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't use the word 'coup' around m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't use the word 'coup' around me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course we will follow through...."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course we will follow through. The Kingdom of Rizia keeps its promises."

entries.dialogueText: She made another note and then closed her book, looking pleased.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks to both of you for your har..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to both of you for your hard work and good advice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Our share is staying the same and we're making concessions to Morella. How is that a coup?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Very wise of you.""

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Since you opted for nationalizatio..."
entries.dialogueText: "Since you opted for nationalization, our choices are limited."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Of course. Your Majesty. It won't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. Your Majesty. It won't happen again."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We've found a balance that satisfi..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've found a balance that satisfies everyone. Isn't that worth celebrating?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""You're too kind, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're too kind, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel

entries.dialogueText: "Your optimism is inspiring, Your Majesty."

entries.dialogueText: She checked her notes.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Morella currently won't approve an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella currently won't approve any MITZ agreement where Rizia keeps its current profit share."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""So the only other choice I see is..."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""As for Morella's remaining demands..."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, the Chancellor will undoubtedly be pleased..."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner

entries.dialogueText: Laurento still looked troubled.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel

entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. Somehow."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I suppose not...""
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose not..."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Indeed a lovely outcome.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed a lovely outcome."

entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Treasury funds have already been e..."
entries.dialogueText: "Treasury funds have already been earmarked for the rehabilitation of the Arufelde watershed. They will be transferred to Morella once the agreement has been approved."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Rizian Oil and Gas will begin work..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizian Oil and Gas will begin work on a pipeline from Rizia to Morella in order to fulfill the energy deal we have promised."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We are working with the Morellans..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are working with the Morellans to come up with a plan for the implementation of stricter labor and environmental regulations in the MITZ."

entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I am currently in talks with the D..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am currently in talks with the Derdian foreign ministry. You should be able to meet with Supreme Wiseman Azmal soon to discuss Prime Minister Saltana's request."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel

entries.dialogueText: "I suspect you will not get very far with Mr. Azmal without rescinding it."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner

entries.dialogueText: "As do I, Your Majesty."

entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""With Lespia and Rizia as a united..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Lespia and Rizia as a united front, the vote will be split 50-50. The regulation and ownership of the Meftiem basin will have to remain the same."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We *gave* Lespia those rights. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "We *gave* Lespia those rights. They can't stab us in the back like that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That'd be just like Alvarez. The s..."
entries.dialogueText: "That'd be just like Alvarez. The sneaky bastard."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""They can and they will.""
entries.dialogueText: "They can and they will."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""He feels the same way about us, I'..."
entries.dialogueText: "He feels the same way about us, I'm sure."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It would be a big help, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would be a big help, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Something really must be done abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Something really must be done about that gas field."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena raised an eyebrow."
entries.dialogueText: Elena raised an eyebrow.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Something like what, Your Majesty?..."
entries.dialogueText: "Something like what, Your Majesty? We had our chance to claim it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Prime Minister Saltana would never..."
entries.dialogueText: "Prime Minister Saltana would never get into bed with the Reinharts."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Morella needs energy badly enough..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella needs energy badly enough to overlook old grudges, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""If Morella and Lespia do end up pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "If Morella and Lespia do end up presenting a united front, we will need Valgsland's help to oppose them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Saltana's bark is worse than her b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Saltana's bark is worse than her bite. I'm not worried."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very serious. We should be steppin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very serious. We should be stepping up our anti-revolutionary efforts."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Internal security is not your conc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Internal security is not your concern, Mr. Esquibel. Please stick to foreign policy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I couldn't tell. I was too thirsty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't tell. I was too thirsty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Of course, Your Majesty. I did not..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Your Majesty. I did not mean to overstep."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""A wise precaution, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "A wise precaution, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""You know better than I do, Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know better than I do, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Ah, the old Morellan sukhar trick...."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, the old Morellan sukhar trick. I should have warned you about that..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you both for your hard work..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you both for your hard work and good advice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Excellent. That gold is ours alrea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excellent. That gold is ours already."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wish it had not come to this. Bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish it had not come to this. But one way or another, we will find a way forward."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I sense your doubt, Laurento. Have..."
entries.dialogueText: "I sense your doubt, Laurento. Have faith in your king and the divine hand that is guiding him."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, Your Majesty. I will.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty. I will."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I agree, Your Majesty. We just hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree, Your Majesty. We just have to be prepared for it to take a while."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It may take a while. But we will f..."
entries.dialogueText: "It may take a while. But we will find a way out of this."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""It's what we are here for, Your Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's what we are here for, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Barring any unexpected unpleasantn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Barring any unexpected unpleasantness, we can expect both Morella and Valgsland to support this arrangement at the next board meeting. It'll be three against one."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Barring any unplanned hiccups, we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Barring any unplanned hiccups, we can expect Morella to support this agreement at the next MITZ board meeting. But we still need one more country's support for a majority."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Chancellor Hegel has expressed his..."
entries.dialogueText: "Chancellor Hegel has expressed his reluctance to support any non-nationalization plan that involves Lespia. So we will have to hope that he comes around."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""As part of this deal, Ms. Saltana..."
entries.dialogueText: "As part of this deal, Ms. Saltana is asking for the immediate construction of a pipeline from Rizia to Morella. The energy partnership will come into full effect when it is complete."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""If all goes well, it will be compl..."
entries.dialogueText: "If all goes well, it will be complete in time for the gas to start flowing once the new MITZ agreement is ratified."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""On the bright side, if this deal c..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the bright side, if this deal comes to fruition, the Morellans will pay for the construction of an energy pipeline from our country to theirs. Effective immediately."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""What's more, if this deal comes to..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's more, if this deal comes to fruition, the Morellans will pay for the construction of an energy pipeline from our country to theirs. Effective immediately."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""While we have you here, a word on..."
entries.dialogueText: "While we have you here, a word on Pales."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Right, yes. Rizian Oil and Gas is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Right, yes. Rizian Oil and Gas is finishing up work on the pipeline that will carry gas from the Aureus field to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Once drilling begins next year, we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Once drilling begins next year, we can expect high returns, even factoring in the royalties we'll have to pay to Pales."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Right, yes. Rizian Oil and Gas is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Right, yes. Rizian Oil and Gas is finishing up work on the pipeline that will carry gas from our section of the Aureus field to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Because of the small area allocate..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because of the small area allocated to us and the royalties we have to pay to Lespia and Pales, we can't expect high returns. But it'll be something."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Right, yes. The arguments are stil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Right, yes. The arguments are still being presented in our arbitration case."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded at Elena."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded at Elena.

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Of course, Lespia's support of Pal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Lespia's support of Pales counts for a lot. But we've received a number of statements in our favor from neighbors and other AN members."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Rumburg and the rest of GRACE, of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rumburg and the rest of GRACE, of course. And, surprisingly, Valgsland."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I knew our comrades could be count..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew our comrades could be counted on."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Valgsland's only supporting us out..."
entries.dialogueText: "Valgsland's only supporting us out of self-interest. If Pales wins, its own islands' economic zones will be in danger."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I reluctantly accept Chancellor He..."
entries.dialogueText: "I reluctantly accept Chancellor Hegel's support."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your people come through in a pinc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your people come through in a pinch, Ms. Werner."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Please, Your Majesty. I don't iden..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Your Majesty. I don't identify with what Valgsland has become."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Still, their backing is extremely..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, their backing is extremely valuable."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We share a belief in the sanctity..."
entries.dialogueText: "We share a belief in the sanctity of economic zones. That's all I know."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Whatever his motivations, Valgslan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever his motivations, Valgsland's backing is extremely valuable."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Say no more. I'll talk to Vina.""
entries.dialogueText: "Say no more. I'll talk to Vina."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""There's one small snag. The Palesi..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's one small snag. The Palesians are requesting that we send a diplomatic liaison to Castle Reinhart to oversee the last stages of the deal."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Evidently, the fact that we backed..."
entries.dialogueText: "Evidently, the fact that we backed out of our original deal has the Duke worried we'll get cold feet about this one, too."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Evidently, our willingness to work..."
entries.dialogueText: "Evidently, our willingness to work with Morella on a nationalization plan got the Duke worried."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Evidently, the Duke still has ques..."
entries.dialogueText: "Evidently, the Duke still has questions about Rizia's true intentions when it comes to his country."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Everything has been running smooth..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everything has been running smoothly so far. I'm sure it's just a standard precaution."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Knowing what we now know about Pal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Knowing what we now know about Pales' possible involvement in the Zille bombing, I'm beginning to question this deal myself."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""And for what it's worth, Pales has..."
entries.dialogueText: "And for what it's worth, Pales has been nothing but cooperative during the preliminary construction process."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It's wise to ask questions. But I..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's wise to ask questions. But I must remind you that we still lack concrete evidence."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't shake the feeling that Rei..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't shake the feeling that Reinhart has *something* up his sleeve."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""For what it's worth, Your Majesty,..."
entries.dialogueText: "For what it's worth, Your Majesty, Pales has been nothing but cooperative during the preliminary construction process."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our deal was with Lespia, wasn't i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our deal was with Lespia, wasn't it? Why is Pales the one asking for a liaison?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Pales still owns the field, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales still owns the field, Your Majesty. The deal will have to be ratified by all three countries."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agreed to pay everything he was..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agreed to pay everything he was asking for. I think I've earned his trust."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I know, Your Majesty. But this wou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know, Your Majesty. But this would only be for a short while."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A reasonable request. As long as i..."
entries.dialogueText: "A reasonable request. As long as it's not for too long."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It should only be for a short whil..."
entries.dialogueText: "It should only be for a short while, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Yes, even if Lespia and Rizia are..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, even if Lespia and Rizia are sharing the rights, Pales will still be keeping a close eye on the extraction and export process."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Still, I would prefer not to send..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, I would prefer not to send anyone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't we already have a diplomatic..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't we already have a diplomatic envoy in Pales? Can we use them?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I assume we'll be sending a diplom..."
entries.dialogueText: "I assume we'll be sending a diplomatic envoy, then?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Will you be fulfilling the liaison..."
entries.dialogueText: "Will you be fulfilling the liaison role, Laurento?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We certainly could. But Duke Reinh..."
entries.dialogueText: "We certainly could. But Duke Reinhart's ministers have hinted that he would prefer the presence of a higher-level individual."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We certainly could do so. But Duke..."
entries.dialogueText: "We certainly could do so. But Duke Reinhart's ministers have hinted that he would prefer the presence of a higher-level individual."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Ha! No, I've got my hands full, I'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ha! No, I've got my hands full, I'm afraid. And I'm too old for the travel such a role entails."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Understood, Your Majesty. But if y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Understood, Your Majesty. But if you change your mind, Duke Reinhart's ministers have hinted he would prefer the presence of a high-level individual."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""This seems like a mostly symbolic..."
entries.dialogueText: "This seems like a mostly symbolic position, geared toward someone young, energetic and quick-witted."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Someone who commands respect, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "Someone who commands respect, but is able to leave the capital for a six-month stretch without it affecting government operations."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He and Elena slowly turned to look..."
entries.dialogueText: He and Elena slowly turned to look at each other, realization dawning on their faces.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""And we do know the Duke enjoys the..."
entries.dialogueText: "And we do know the Duke enjoys the company of the fairer sex..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You want me to pimp out my daughte..."
entries.dialogueText: "You want me to pimp out my daughter to Axel Reinhart?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Elena frowned disapprovingly."
entries.dialogueText: Elena frowned disapprovingly.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I'm certain Her Highness would be..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm certain Her Highness would be a great help, Your Majesty. But it's up to you. And the princess, of course."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Nothing so vulgar, right, Laurento..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing so vulgar, right, Laurento? The presence of the Princess at Castle Reinhart would force the Duke to be on his best behavior."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. Absolutely out of the question.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. Absolutely out of the question."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""But I understand your hesitation...."
entries.dialogueText: "But I understand your hesitation. I'm sure a standard diplomatic envoy would be effective as well."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hmm. I have been thinking that my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hmm. I have been thinking that my daughter would benefit from spending time abroad."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento looked disappointed."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento looked disappointed.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Are you sure, Your Majesty? I feel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure, Your Majesty? I feel that Her Highness would be a great help."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I'm sure a standard diplomatic env..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure a standard diplomatic envoy would be just as effective, Laurento."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I did love to travel when I was he..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did love to travel when I was her age. Boat rides excepted."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I am certain Her Highness would be..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am certain Her Highness would be a great help, Your Majesty. But it's up to you. And the princess, of course."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""You don't have to make the decisio..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't have to make the decision right away. But the Palesians are expecting an answer soon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll speak with Vina and let you k..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll speak with Vina and let you know what she says."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand. I will get back to y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. I will get back to you soon with my decision."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've already decided. We'll use ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've already decided. We'll use our existing diplomatic envoy for the job."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've already decided. We'll send a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've already decided. We'll send a regular envoy."
entries.menuText: "I've already decided. We'll send a regular envoy." [-1 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tell Pales that there will be no l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell Pales that there will be no liaison."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I... I see, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I... I see, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I don't see the need for it, anywa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't see the need for it, anyway. The deal is as good as done."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Right away, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Right away, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""There shouldn't be much for them t..."
entries.dialogueText: "There shouldn't be much for them to do, anyway. The deal is as good as signed."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, Your Majesty. I'll give the o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty. I'll give the order straight away."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We've gone long past our allotted..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've gone long past our allotted time. Why don't we call it a day?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""An excellent suggestion as usual,..."
entries.dialogueText: "An excellent suggestion as usual, Ms. Werner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Gladly. I've had enough foreign po..."
entries.dialogueText: "Gladly. I've had enough foreign policy talk for a lifetime."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would happily keep working. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would happily keep working. But for your sake, let us adjourn."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Morella has little clout with the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella has little clout with the AN, but in combination with other factors, the support Ms. Saltana has promised could help tip the scales."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We certainly cannot count on Morel..."
entries.dialogueText: "We certainly cannot count on Morella's support now. But they have little clout with the AN anyway."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""If our agreement with Morella proc..."
entries.dialogueText: "If our agreement with Morella proceeds as planned, we may earn their support. Though our neighbor has little clout with the AN on its own."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Unfortunately, I highly doubt Pres..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, I highly doubt President Smolak will be motivated to speak in our favor."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""If President Smolak was serious ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "If President Smolak was serious about wanting to renew ties between our countries, he will speak in our favor."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""As for Derdia, it appears highly u..."
entries.dialogueText: "As for Derdia, it appears highly unlikely that the committee will be hearing from Supreme Wiseman Azmal."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""As for Derdia, Supreme Wiseman Azm..."
entries.dialogueText: "As for Derdia, Supreme Wiseman Azmal does not hate us, but nor does he have a reason to stick his neck out for us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand. Thank you for the up..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. Thank you for the update."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Anything else we can do to sway th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anything else we can do to sway the vote in our favor?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And our naval efforts? Do those ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "And our naval efforts? Do those have an impact one way or another?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sounds like we've got this in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sounds like we've got this in the bag."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""With pleasure, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "With pleasure, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Not at this point, Your Majesty. T..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not at this point, Your Majesty. There's not much we can do but wait for the results."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Difficult to say, Your Majesty. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Difficult to say, Your Majesty. There's not much we can do but wait for the results."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""I truly hope you're right.""
entries.dialogueText: "I truly hope you're right."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""To be honest, I was uncomfortable..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be honest, I was uncomfortable with supporting Su Omina in Zille from the start."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We need Zille back, Mr. Esquibel...."
entries.dialogueText: "We need Zille back, Mr. Esquibel. At all costs."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I appreciate your feedback. But it..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your feedback. But it's too late to back out now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've made my decision, Mr. Esquibe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've made my decision, Mr. Esquibel. I don't want to hear another word from you about this."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Of course the reclamation of our t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course the reclamation of our territory is of the utmost importance, but..."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I-- yes, of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "I-- yes, of course."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, Your Majesty. My lips are sea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty. My lips are sealed."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Never mind.""
entries.dialogueText: "Never mind."

entries.dialogueText: "Everyone has a price, Your Majesty. Even Valgslandian Socialists."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We may be left with no choice.""
entries.dialogueText: "We may be left with no choice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hegel seemed receptive to dealing..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hegel seemed receptive to dealing with us. Of course, that was before negotiations with Morella stalled out."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""True. If he is willing to bargain,..."
entries.dialogueText: "True. If he is willing to bargain, his price is much higher now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Trust me, we have nothing to worry..."
entries.dialogueText: "Trust me, we have nothing to worry about. Lespia won't budge against Morella."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I... hope you are right.""
entries.dialogueText: "I... hope you are right."

entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""At any rate, all we can do at this..."
entries.dialogueText: "At any rate, all we can do at this point is wait. If I hear of any counter-deals being made, we will talk about our next steps."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The question is whether Morella wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The question is whether Morella will accept that. How serious did Saltana seem about her threat to send Malenyevist revolutionaries to Rizia?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""At any rate, all we can do at this..."
entries.dialogueText: "At any rate, all we can do at this point is wait and keep watch. I will inform you of any future developments."

entries.dialogueText: "I only agreed to nationalization to have leverage over Morella. If I can't, then I will fight with Lespia to keep the status quo."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Either we strike demands from our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Either we strike demands from our list, or give up renegotiation completely."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I refuse to make an unfair deal. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I refuse to make an unfair deal. I'd rather fight with Lespia to keep the status quo."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""A respectable decision, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "A respectable decision, Your Majesty. But I hope you're prepared for the fallout."
